summaries.name: Oakwood
summaries.summary: Oakwood is a neighborhood where the user viewed a 3-bedroom bungalow on January 22nd that needed serious kitchen renovation work.

summaries.name: Brookside
summaries.summary: Brookside is where the user is finalizing the purchase of a townhouse, as of March 8, 2023, and is planning a kitchen renovation with quartz countertops there.

summaries.name: Houzz
summaries.summary: Houzz is a resource for finding kitchen designers, contractors, and remodeling professionals, filterable by location, with reviews and portfolios; also useful for gathering kitchen design inspiration.

summaries.name: National Kitchen and Bath Association (NKBA)
summaries.summary: The National Kitchen and Bath Association (NKBA) can be used to find certified kitchen designers and professionals in a given area.

summaries.name: National Association of the Remodeling Industry (NARI)
summaries.summary: The National Association of the Remodeling Industry (NARI) provides a list of certified remodeling professionals, including kitchen contractors.

summaries.name: National Association of Realtors
summaries.summary: According to the National Association of Realtors, kitchen renovation projects have high ROI at resale: new appliances have 102% ROI, kitchen renovation overall 80-100% ROI, countertops 70-90% ROI, and cabinets 60-80% ROI.

summaries.name: Floor & Decor
summaries.summary: Floor & Decor, with multiple locations in the area, offers a wide range of quartz countertop brands and styles, including Caesarstone, Cambria, and Silestone.
